landing.does.title: Created for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable internet and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at a different time, with weak or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was created exactly for that.
landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time fills up, customers can't choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, on the tablet at the counter, on the laptop in the van — and on the card terminal you already take payment with.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in the dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you drive to the trading spot or stand at the grill, based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will get answered while you drive to the trading spot or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram follow after.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online orders pause automatically, so customers don't send orders you won't see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.steps.title: Set everything up and start taking orders in about 15 minutes.
landing.steps.lede: Three things to sort out — and for two of them you only need a photo.
landing.steps.menuBody: Photograph the menu board or paste in the text. Items, prices and extras carry over on their own. You just check they are correct.
landing.steps.scheduleBody: Have it on your website? We'll read it from there and keep it up to date. If not, photograph that too. You just approve what is found.
landing.steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR code on the van. Orders arrive on your screen, in the order you need to cook them.
landing.testimonial.quote: HatchGrab has made ordering much easier for us. Everything is organised, we can track stock and know exactly how many pizzas we still have left to sell — and the time slots are fantastic for busy villages.
landing.pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you need to.
landing.pricing.switchBody: See how much you would pay on HatchGrab for the same orders. Takes about one minute.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.metaDescription: Clear answers for food truck owners: HatchGrab's prices, setting up, taking orders and paying by card or on collection.
landing.final.title: Want to see how easy setting up is?
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of the menu and in under 60 seconds we'll turn it into a working ordering page for you to try out. Your items, your prices. No registration, no card, nothing to install. Have a look, then decide.

featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage walk-up orders, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to work with HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Work with several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the appropriate level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders pause, so customers don't send orders you won't see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth printer or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service from a browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it immediately turns grey for customers.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a stock level and it goes down as orders arrive, then the item automatically becomes sold out.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to the order when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep certificates in one place, for example for food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before something expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter how much each dish costs you and see how much you really earned at each event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don't need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, with order numbers and when they're ready.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Charge by card in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection slot, spreading orders across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a slot fills up, customers can't choose it.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don't show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show upcoming dates on your website. Each one leads straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on HatchGrab's public map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with separate prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram questions.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically notify customers by SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.

aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes practical software for food trucks and catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.title: Created around the way food trucks really work
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with one simple observation: food trucks need better tools for running the business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I created Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover the food trucks that come to their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike classic restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software intended specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, which helps them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time on questions that keep repeating.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools created around how these businesses really work.
